versions.changelog: Improve OpenClaw-native update guidance based on real-world use: prefer gentler per-skill updates before falling back to openclaw skills update --all, document ClawHub 429 handling, add current-session summary guidance, and refine cron examples for lower-friction maintenance.

Initial public release. OpenClaw-native auto-updater skill with cron-based skill maintenance guidance, current-session reporting guidance, and gentler per-skill update strategy for ClawHub rate limits.
